title: The Power of a Praying Wife
author: Stormie Omartian
edition_analyzed: Revised and Expanded Edition (most recent widely available edition)
target_audience: Wives seeking to strengthen their marriage through faith and prayer
Individuals looking for faith-based relationship advice
Church study groups or women's ministry members
core_themes: The transformative power of prayer in marriage
Commitment, love, and forgiveness within marital relationships
Letting go of control and trusting God with your spouse
primary_purpose: To guide wives in supporting their husbands and nurturing their marriages through targeted, scripture-based prayers, while fostering personal spiritual growth and connection with God.

structure_format.narrative_style: Conversational, encouraging, and instructional with firsthand reflections
structure_format.organization: Divided into specific topical chapters, each addressing a key aspect of a husband's life (e.g., work, health, spirituality, fatherhood), followed by sample prayers and relevant Bible verses

key_concepts_lessons: Prayer can bring about positive change in a marriage by focusing on God’s will rather than control.
Specific, intentional prayers for a husband’s life areas can foster intimacy and understanding.
Letting go of resentment and forgiving are essential spiritual acts in marriage.
Spiritual growth is as important to marital health as practical communication skills.
God’s guidance and grace are central to overcoming marital struggles and challenges.
notable_features: 31 stand-alone chapters for daily or weekly prayer focus
Each chapter centers on a different area of a husband's life
Widely used in church groups and Christian counseling settings
Includes journaling space in some editions
cultural_historical_context: Emerging in the late 1990s during a period of renewed interest in practical Christian spirituality and women's devotional literature, the book leveraged the popularity of faith-based approaches to personal and marital growth.
reception_impact: International bestseller status with millions of copies sold
Praised for encouraging wives to rely on prayer, not just self-effort, in marriage
Frequently used in Bible studies, marriage seminars, and counseling
Some criticism from secular or non-Christian audiences for its exclusively faith-based and traditional gender role focus
comparable_titles: The Power of a Praying Husband by Stormie Omartian
The Power of a Praying Parent by Stormie Omartian
Praying Circles Around Your Marriage by Joel & Nina Schmidgall
Love & Respect by Dr. Emerson Eggerichs
